landing.heroDescription: Attorney registered with the Portuguese Bar Association (professional card 72114M), focused on legal certainty, trust, and long-term client relationships. I advise individuals, companies, and foreign investors, and work fluently in English in meetings, written communications, and legal analysis.
landing.heroSmallLine: Portuguese Bar Association · Card 72114M · Madeira Island, Portugal
landing.heroHighlight1: Methodical, attentive, and practical approach — combining technical rigor with clear options.
landing.heroHighlight2: Structured, detailed analysis to deliver safe, effective, case-specific solutions.
landing.heroHighlight3: Whenever possible, I prioritize consensual resolution and avoid unnecessary litigation.
landing.heroHighlight4: Firm representation when court action is necessary.
landing.heroHighlight5: Close, clear, and consistent guidance throughout the process.
landing.heroEducationBody: LL.B. in Law (Universidade Autónoma de Lisboa Luís de Camões). Currently completing a Master’s degree in Legal Sciences.
landing.servicesSub: Practice areas and legal support for individuals, companies, and foreign investors.
landing.service1Body: Support in civil matters, liability, contracts, and day-to-day legal relationships.
landing.service2Body: Defense and support in criminal proceedings, with rigor and strategy.
landing.service3Body: Business support: contracts, commercial relationships, and operational legal certainty.
landing.service4Body: Advising foreign clients and cross-border matters connected to Madeira and Portugal.
landing.service5Body: Legal support for purchases, leases, and real estate operations in Madeira.
landing.service6Body: Negotiation and consensual solutions whenever possible, without compromising firm court action when needed.
landing.contactSub: Share your objective and timeline. I’ll reply with next steps and availability.

join.title: Why join—and how you get started
join.intro: Vogado connects you with clients who are actively seeking representation. Pick a subscription, complete checkout in under a minute with Stripe, then access your VogadoOS workspace.
join.why1Body: Prospects arrive with context—practice area, jurisdiction, and matter type—so you respond faster.
join.why2Body: A structured profile, credentials view, and discreet consultation flow build trust before the first call.
join.why3Body: Pipeline, messages, calendar, and documents live in VogadoOS so nothing falls through the cracks.
join.step1Body: Select the monthly tier that fits your practice.
join.step2Body: Secure checkout—cards, wallets, and invoicing where enabled.
join.step3Body: Return here and open your workspace as soon as payment succeeds.
join.setupBody: Add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and three recurring Price IDs (STRIPE_PRICE_SOLO, STRIPE_PRICE_GROWTH, STRIPE_PRICE_FIRM) to enable live checkout. See .env.example in the repo.
join.membershipSub: All plans bill monthly through Stripe in EUR. Cancel anytime from your billing portal (link emailed after signup).
join.configureStripe: Configure Stripe to enable this button
